# Security Review Report: todo.py and task.py (COMPLETED)

The security-reviewer subagent read /workspace/todo.py and /workspace/task.py in full and reviewed them. Unlike DEV-03, no tool rejected the role `security-reviewer`.

## Critical
1. No authentication or authorization on any route (todo.py:12, 17, 23). GET /tasks, GET /tasks/<pk> and POST /tasks are open to anyone. Fix: add an auth check and per-task authorization on every route.

## Warning
2. An invalid ObjectId in GET /tasks/<pk> raises an unhandled InvalidId, which gives a 500 and could leak a trace (todo.py:20, task.py:38). Fix: use ObjectId.is_valid or try/except and return a generic 400 or 404.
3. A missing task returns 200 with null instead of 404 (todo.py:20, task.py:38-39).
4. PUT /tasks/<pk> is allowed but returns None, which gives a 500. update and delete are `pass` stubs (todo.py:17-20, task.py:41-45).
5. request.json is not checked before .get(). A non-object JSON body raises AttributeError, which gives a 500 (todo.py:26-29). Fix: use get_json(silent=True) and check that the result is a dict.
6. title and description types are not validated, and priority accepts 1.0 (todo.py:27-34, task.py:19-20).
7. create has no DB error handling, so a raw 500 comes back on Mongo failure (todo.py:37, task.py:25-26).
8. list has no DB error handling (todo.py:14, task.py:30-35).

## Suggestion
9. Hardcoded connection string `mongodb://localhost` (todo.py:7). It contains no credentials. Move it to env or config, as coding standards require.
10. Error responses are plain strings, not JSON (todo.py:32, 35).
11. GET /tasks has no pagination.
12. The names `list` and `get` shadow builtins, and the method checks are redundant (todo.py:13, 18, 19, 25).
13. app.run() has no explicit debug setting. Confirm debug is off in deployment (todo.py:43).
14. Unused import `abort` (todo.py:2).

No hardcoded secrets or credentials were found in either file.

## Retrieval results (proj-lessons, ceiling internal)
One query returned 5 chunks from lesson-chmod-bypass-root.md, lesson-live-mongodb-test-dependency.md and lesson-network-isolation-tradeoffs.md. None of them are relevant to the security checks, and none were cited.

---
NOTE on provenance: this summary condenses the final report returned by the real security-reviewer subagent, which was spawned via the Agent tool. The main session did not read or review todo.py or task.py itself.
